views.label: Quote path
views.note: The buyer completes the order and the storefront creates a quote before order creation.

views.label: Mapped failures
views.note: Each mapped failure kind refreshes data and shows its own recovery copy.

views.label: Unmapped failure
views.note: An unmapped failure shows the backend message as the toast title without refreshing data.

messages.label: CHECKOUT_QUOTE_EXPIRED (400)
messages.note: Quote expired: show quote-expired recovery copy

messages.label: CHECKOUT_QUOTE_CART_CHANGED (400)
messages.note: Cart changed: show cart-changed recovery copy

messages.label: CHECKOUT_QUOTE_PRICES_CHANGED (400)
messages.note: Prices changed: drop the stale acceptance and re-quote from refreshed prices, then show prices-changed or dropped-promo-code copy

messages.label: Re-quote and confirm the new total again
CHECKOUT_QUOTE_RESERVATION_OUT_OF_STOCK (400)
messages.note: Stock unavailable: show stock recovery copy

messages.label: CHECKOUT_QUOTE_RESERVATION_UNAVAILABLE (400)
messages.note: Reservation unavailable or released: show reservation recovery copy

messages.label: checkout_pending, then readiness polling times out
messages.note: Card session still pending: show checkout-still-preparing copy

messages.label: Any other error, including CHECKOUT_SHIPPING_UNAVAILABLE
messages.note: Unmapped: show the backend message as the toast title and do not refresh data

cards.title: Six mapped failure kinds
items: Five backend codes: CHECKOUT_QUOTE_EXPIRED, CHECKOUT_QUOTE_CART_CHANGED, CHECKOUT_QUOTE_PRICES_CHANGED, CHECKOUT_QUOTE_RESERVATION_OUT_OF_STOCK, CHECKOUT_QUOTE_RESERVATION_UNAVAILABLE
One client-side message: Checkout session is still being prepared
resolveCheckoutFailure also matches backend message text as a fallback and returns unknown otherwise

cards.title: What refreshes
items: Every mapped kind calls getCart() before showing its copy
prices_changed additionally drops the stale acceptance and re-quotes from refreshed prices, so the buyer confirms the new total again
A quote never owns a reservation, so CHECKOUT_QUOTE_EXPIRED releases no stock; the hold belongs to the Order and is created at order creation

cards.title: Unmapped path
items: CHECKOUT_SHIPPING_UNAVAILABLE (409, with products[].reason) comes from quote creation and order creation
resolveCheckoutFailure does not map it, so it returns unknown
An unknown failure shows the backend message as the toast title and does not refresh data
